spans.s:
mf. (-गः-गा)
A traveller.
m. (-गः)
1 A camel.
2 The sun.
f. (-गा)
A name of the river Ganges.
E.
अध्वन् a road, and ग who goes, from गम, with ड aff.

n. (-नं)
Journeying, travelling.
E.
अध्वन, and गमन going.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Travelling, a traveller.
E.
अध्वन and गामिन् who goes.

m. (-ग्यः)
A tree, (Spondias mangifera.)
E.
अध्वग a traveller, and भोग्य to be enjoyed by.

Correcting viscidity, dilution of the phlegm and marrow.
E.
अत to go constantly, क्वनिप् affix; ध substituted for त.

mf. (-नः-ना)
A traveller.
E.
अध्वन्, and त्व aff.

mf. (-न्यः-न्या)
A traveller.
E.
अध्वन्, and यत् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A sacrifice.
2 A Vasu, or a kind of demigod.
3 Intent, attentive, careful.
E.
अ neg. ध्वृ^1 to bend or make crooked, and अच् affix; or अध्व a road, and र from रा to give; leading to heaven.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 314. note: cf. WIL, MW.

m. (-थः)
A travelling carriage or cart.
E.
अध्वन् a road, and रथ a carriage.

m. (-र्य्युः)
A Brahman versed in the Yajurveda.
E.
अध्वर a sacrifice, क्यच् and उ affix, अ being dropped.

m. (-ल्यः)
A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) See अपमार्ग.
E.
अध्वन्, and शल्य a stake.

n. (-न्तं)
Gloom, twilight.
E.
अ neg. ध्यान्त darkness.

m. (-वः)
A plant, (Cassia fistula.) See पत्रोर्ण.
E.
अ neg. ध्वान्त darkness, शावव inimical; blossoming in the shade.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Belonging, to the officiating priest.
E.
अध्वर्य्यु and अञ् aff.
